Bash("/e/develop/anaconda3/envs/sentiment/python.exe" -c "
from TopicCluster.database.connection import execute_query

# 平台分布
print\(''各话题的平台分布:''\)
topics = execute_query\(''''''
    SELECT te.id, te.event_name, te.platform_distribution
    FROM topic_event te WHERE te.status <> ''merged'' AND te.content_count >= 5
    ORDER BY te.content_count DESC
''''''\)
import json
for t in topics:
    pd = t[''platform_distribution'']
    if isinstance\(pd, str\):
        pd = json.loads\(pd\)
    print\(f''  话题 {t[""id""]} \({t[""event_name""][:30]}\): {pd}''\)

# 总体情感分布
print\(\)
print\(''情感分布统计:''\)
sentiment = execute_query\(''''''
    SELECT dominant_sentiment, COUNT\(*\) as cnt, AVG\(content_count\) as avg_size
    FROM topic_event WHERE status <> ''merged'' AND dominant_sentiment IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY dominant_sentiment
''''''\)
for s in sentiment:
    print\(f''  {s[""dominant_sentiment""]:>10}: {s[""cnt""]} 个话题, 平均 {float\(s[""avg_size""]\):.1f} 条内容''\)
")

Bash("/e/develop/anaconda3/envs/sentiment/python.exe" -c "
from TopicCluster.database.connection import execute_query

# 查看每个大话题的代表性内容
print\(''各大话题的代表性内容:''\)
print\(''='' * 80\)

big_topics = execute_query\(''''''
    SELECT id, event_name, content_count FROM topic_event
    WHERE status <> ''merged'' AND content_count >= 5
    ORDER BY content_count DESC
''''''\)

for t in big_topics:
    print\(f''\\n话题 {t[""id""]}: {t[""event_name""]} \({t[""content_count""]} 条\)''\)
    print\(''-'' * 60\)
    contents = execute_query\(''''''
        SELECT uc.id, pc.title_cleaned
        FROM unified_content uc
        JOIN processed_content pc ON pc.unified_id = uc.id
        WHERE uc.topic_id = %s
        ORDER BY uc.topic_similarity DESC
        LIMIT 5
    '''''', \(t[''id''],\)\)
    for c in contents:
        title = \(c[''title_cleaned''] or ''''\)[:70]
        print\(f''  {title}''\)
")
